title: Ad comments
content:
# Ad comments

Read the comments on a TikTok ad, Spark Ads included, then reply to, hide or delete them.

import { Tab, Tabs } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/tabs';

Read the comments on a TikTok ad with `GET /v1/ads/{adId}/comments`, then reply to, hide or delete them. It covers paid video ads and Spark Ads, dark posts included.

## Before you start

Comments on organic posts are read and moderated through the [inbox](/platforms/tiktok/inbox#comments) instead.

`{adId}` takes the Zernio `_id` or TikTok's numeric `platformAdId`.

## Read the comments

TikTok reads comments over a date window rather than all of history. `since` and `until` take a `YYYY-MM-DD` date, at most 30 days apart, and default to the last 30 days.

<Tabs items={['Node.js', 'Python', 'curl']}>
<Tab value="Node.js">
```typescript
const { data: thread } = await zernio.adaccounts.getAdComments({
  path: { adId: '1790166588666881' },
  query: { since: '2026-08-15', until: '2026-09-09', limit: 50 }
});

for (const comment of thread.comments) console.log(comment.id, comment.canReply);
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="Python">
```python
thread = client.ad_accounts.get_ad_comments(
    ad_id="1790166588666881",
    since="2026-08-15",
    until="2026-09-09",
    limit=50,
)

for comment in thread["comments"]:
    print(comment["id"], comment["canReply"])
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="curl">
```bash
curl "https://zernio.com/api/v1/ads/1790166588666881/comments?since=2026-08-15&until=2026-09-09&limit=50" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY"
```
</Tab>
</Tabs>

Response (`200`), trimmed:

```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "comments": [
    {
      "id": "7412345678901234567",
      "message": "Does this come in blue?",
      "canReply": true,
      "canDelete": false,
      "canHide": true
    }
  ],
  "pagination": { "hasMore": true, "cursor": "..." },
  "meta": { "platform": "tiktok", "adId": "66f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0", "platformAdId": "1790166588666881", "tiktokItemId": null }
}
```

The response shape matches `GET /v1/inbox/comments/{postId}`. Page with `pagination.cursor` and the same `limit`: the cursor carries the date window, so do not re-send the dates.

TikTok returns replies as separate comments with `parentId`. Nested reply fetching is not supported.

## Reply to a comment

Reply to a first-level comment with `POST /v1/ads/{adId}/comments/{commentId}/reply`. Replies to replies are rejected.

<Tabs items={['Node.js', 'Python', 'curl']}>
<Tab value="Node.js">
```typescript
const { data: reply } = await zernio.adaccounts.replyToAdComment({
  path: { adId: '1790166588666881', commentId: '7412345678901234567' },
  body: { text: 'Thanks, sending you the specs now.' }
});
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="Python">
```python
reply = client.ad_accounts.reply_to_ad_comment(
    ad_id="1790166588666881",
    comment_id="7412345678901234567",
    text="Thanks, sending you the specs now.",
)
```
</Tab>
<Tab value="curl">
```bash
curl -X POST "https://zernio.com/api/v1/ads/1790166588666881/comments/7412345678901234567/reply" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "text": "Thanks, sending you the specs now." }'
```
</Tab>
</Tabs>

Response (`200`):

```json
{ "status": "success", "commentId": "7512345678901234567" }
```

`commentId` is the new reply. The reply is not idempotent, so do not retry an uncertain response blindly.

## Hide or delete a comment

`POST /v1/ads/{adId}/comments/{commentId}/hide` with `{ "hidden": true }` hides any comment. Send `{ "hidden": false }` to make it public again.

`DELETE /v1/ads/{adId}/comments/{commentId}` deletes your own comment or reply. Other users' comments can be hidden instead.

```bash
curl -X POST "https://zernio.com/api/v1/ads/1790166588666881/comments/7412345678901234567/hide" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "hidden": true }'

curl -X DELETE "https://zernio.com/api/v1/ads/1790166588666881/comments/7412345678901234567" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY"
```

Response (`200`) to the hide:

```json
{ "status": "success", "commentId": "7412345678901234567", "hidden": true }
```

The moderation routes take the same `since` and `until` as the listing, because TikTok looks a comment up inside a window.

Pass the window you listed with when you act on a comment near its edge.

## How it behaves

Each comment carries three flags:

| Flag | Requires |
|------|----------|
| `canReply` | A first-level comment, comment-management permission, a video item ID and a supported identity (`TT_USER` or `CUSTOMIZED_USER`) |
| `canDelete` | TikTok's own-comment deletion capability, a video item ID and a supported identity |
| `canHide` | Only the advertiser and comment IDs, so it is true without an identity |

- The flags guide the UI and never block the listing. A direct reply or delete can resolve a missing identity or item ID and succeed after a false flag.
- Listing works from the stored ad group alone. `meta.tiktokItemId: null` does not prevent it.
- Listing filters each ad-group page to the requested ad, so a page can be empty while `pagination.hasMore` is true. Keep paging.
- Before moderating, Zernio checks the comment belongs to the ad. The lookup scans at most 2,000 ad-group comments.

## If it fails

| Error | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `400` with code `ad_not_commentable` | The ad has no ad group | Check the ad in TikTok Ads Manager. |
| `400` on `placement` | `placement` is Meta only | Drop the parameter. |
| `403` with code `feature_not_available` | No supported identity, or no own-comment deletion for a delete | Hide the comment instead, or check the ad's identity. |
| `403` with code `insufficient_permissions` | TikTok denied ad-detail access or comment management | Grant the permission and reconnect TikTok Ads. |
| `404` with code `ad_not_found` | TikTok no longer returns the ad (deleted or archived) | Check the ad in TikTok Ads Manager. |
| `404` with code `resource_not_found` | The comment is not on this ad in the date window | Pass the `since` and `until` you listed with, or narrow the window. |
| `502` | TikTok rejected the request or was unavailable | Read `platformError` for TikTok's code and message. |
